sources.snippet: Predictive maintenance is increasingly important in rotating machinery to prevent unexpected failures, reduce downtime, and improve operational efficiency. This study compares the efficacy of traditional machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques in diagnosing bearing faults under varying load and speed conditions.
